item.title: The Breakup
item.description:
This is part of exercises I took in the writing workshop at Esalen in July 2026. This breakup was in 2014. This was on the \(3^{rd}\) day.

I am putting a book in the envelope. “The Little Prince”, has a signature of my now ex-girlfriend and date when it was gifted to me. My hands are steady but there is a volcano bubbling inside. I am angry at her, at my family, at the whole situation.

item.title: Massage in Dubai
item.description:
This is part of exercises I took in the writing workshop at Esalen in July 2026.

I am in a taxi in Dubai, tired to my bones. The Pakistani taxi driver looks at his rearview mirror and says in a thick Punjabi accented English “You look tired”, “you must have a 200 plus IQ”, I wanted to say, but I merely nodded. Even nodding was painful. I had spent 3 weeks in a hospital taking care of my mother who had it not been for the doctors and nurses would not have made it from the medical shock of sepsis.

item.title: Describing emotion without naming it
item.description:
This is part of exercises I took in the writing workshop at Esalen in July 2026. The idea is to describe the emotion without naming it. The reader should be able to guess.

The feeling starts in the gut gently constricting the insides as I pretend to type while putting my full attention to the sounds around me and sense if he is still watching over my shoulders.

The gentle constriction has become tighter and tighter and there is nauseousness in my throat. My buttocks are clenched so hard that I can feel the tightness coming up to my stomach. I can feel the sweat on my feet and my feet slipping in the insole of my leather shoes. My body was preparing to run even as my mind knew there was nowhere to go.
